description: PR1/core. The autonomy seam — HARD RULE 1: no Request/requireUser/headers/reserveBudget imports. generateDraft(seedId): load seed (no-op if status!=queued); set generating; fetch concept labels/defs (SELECT id,label,definition FROM concepts WHERE id=ANY($1) — concepts kept these cols on main, gained harmless family_id); seedToPrefs(seed)->UserPreferences (types.ts:109-130; scope fields only; placeholders for preferredModel/Voice); buildQueryText(concepts,angle); retrieve(queryText,prefs) then GROUNDING GUARD — HARD RULE 2: chunks.length<MIN_CHUNKS(4) -> fail()->needs_attention with NO LLM call. NOTE retrieve() is now a 3-leg hybrid (vector+graph+lexical FTS) and RetrievedChunk gained required source field + optional lexRank/conceptMatchWeight — call site unchanged, chunks_used mapper only reads id/tradition/text_name/section/tier so it tolerates the wider shape. Resolve curated model (isCuratedSlug else DEFAULT_CURATED_SLUG); completeStream collected to completion (mirrors api/query/route.ts:253-268, capture usage incl cached); parseGenerated(raw,concepts) pulls TITLE/DEK, strips CITATIONS, falls back to concept-label title/first-para dek; uniqueSlug(title) (-2/-3 on collision); best-effort computeCost — HARD RULE 3: off user budget (mirrors api/query/route.ts:284-290); store structured chunks_used {id,tradition,text_name,section,tier} (intentional divergence from api/query/route.ts:328 bare ids — comment it). Any throw -> fail()->needs_attention. DONE: queued->draft; thin->needs_attention+no content+no LLM; throw->needs_attention; non-queued re-fire no-op; tsc clean. Tests: blog-generate.test.ts (thin; happy; slug collision; missing head fallback; cost throw->null). DEPS: T1,T2. BLOCKS: T4. See IMPL T3.

resolution.note: generateDraft seam implemented: grounding guard before any LLM call, status lifecycle queued→generating→draft|needs_attention, structured chunks_used, slug-collision suffixing, TITLE/DEK parse with fallbacks, cost off user budget. 9 tests pass; full suite 411 green; tsc clean.
